lessons.prompt:
I'm working through "Start from the Story & the Design" (Build → Implementation) on my own project. Act as my assistant: draft and check, I decide.

Goal: Make sure the developer builds what was asked, to the design that was decided, before the first line is written.
Done looks like: A confirmed 'before you start' checklist, answered questions and a branch cut from the latest main.

I'll attach or paste: Story; UI specification; Architecture description; ADRs; Design readiness record.

Work through these steps with me, one at a time:
1. Read the story and every criterion → Before-you-start checklist
2. Read the design and cited ADRs → Before-you-start checklist
3. Map examples with product and test → Story kick-off notes
4. Anything unclear? (a decision — give me the options and a recommendation; I make the call)
5. Ask and record the answer → Query log
6. Pull main and create the branch → Commits on the branch

Produce: Before-you-start checklist; Query log. Use clear headings I can paste into my document.

Before you finish, check it against: Every required checklist item confirmed; Questions logged with answerer; Checklist confirmed; Questions answered.

Ask me for anything you need instead of guessing. Keep it specific to my project.
